business_summary: Kitazawa Sangyo Co., Ltd. sells food processing machinery and cooking equipment in Japan. It operates through Commercial Kitchen Related Business and Real Estate Leasing segments. The company is also involved in the sale of confectionery and bread-making equipment, which includes WAO bakery system, deck oven, convection oven, pizza oven, dew conditioner, and other equipment; design, manufacture, and sale of kitchen equipment, freezing and refrigeration equipment, and food processing equipment; and inspection, maintenance, and repair of kitchen equipment. In addition, it engages in the design and construction of hotels and restaurant kitchens, as well as catering services in hospitals, schools, etc.; and sale of commercial furniture. Further, the company provides large-scale automatic cleaning equipment, such as container, triple, and conveyor washing machine; washing machine includes instrument cleaning machine, door and under counter type dishwasher, dome return dish washer, rack, pre-rinse shower, cyclone, glass washer, line pump, brush drum, booster, and detergent; and large automatic cooking appliance such as auto fryer, grilling machine, vacuum cooling and powder ring machine, leonider, jet oven, auto-breader, puzzle and handheld filling machine, dehydrator, arm mixer, storage-type boiler, and continuous automatic fryer. Additionally, it provides heating cooking equipment, which includes flyer, steam convection oven, vacuum packaging machine, noodle boiling machine and other equipment. Kitazawa Sangyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
